description: Metagrating inverse-design showcase data (examples/design_metagrating.py, DesignProblem). No optimization was run; densities come from build_problem(seed) and the record.

seed_selection.rule: Recorded objective is the loss -(T+1 at 1.0 um); best final objective = lowest last loss = highest last +1 efficiency. The same seed also leads at the coarse smooth and fine GDS stages.

source.polarization: E along x (the grating vector); TM with respect to the y-invariant lines

densities.initial_definition: build_problem(seed): logits 0.5*randn(Generator seed), sigmoid, periodic conic filter radius 0.125 um, tanh projection beta 4 eta 0.5 (DesignProblem.density() before any step)
densities.final_binary_definition: record["binary"] = DesignProblem.density(hard=True) after 24 steps (beta 64), identical to the exported binary pixels

columns.T_orders_sum: sum of the three transmitted orders
columns.T_total: net flux through the transmitted plane / reference flux
columns.R_total: scattered (total minus incident) flux toward -z at z=-0.8 um / reference flux

spectra.method: GratingForward with the module frequency list replaced by these 41 frequencies for the reference and the design runs, efficiencies() = diffraction_efficiency against that matched reference. T_total and R_total come from build_project(mesh, steps) plus one extra z-normal plane at z=-0.8 um (DifferentiablePlaneSimulation, normalized_flux, subtract_incident for R).

workflow_duration.note: the workflow run length; matches the record

long_duration.note: same forward with 4x the steps; time-converged for the final design

workflow_duration.note: the workflow run length; matches the record

long_duration.note: same forward with 4x the steps; time-converged for the final design

duration_check.note: same forward class with 1x, 2x and 4x the steps (the time step is fixed by the mesh, so the simulated time grows); differences are absolute efficiency

pulse.note: |DFT of the source waveform| over the 800-step coarse run, relative to its global maximum; the reference run at the same frequencies divides it out.

record_check.note: coarse = build_problem forward (50 nm, 800 steps); fine = FineEvaluator forward (25 nm, 1600 steps). Recorded coarse binary values are fabrication.perturbation.nominal, recorded initial values are history[0] (iteration 1 evaluates the design before the first optimizer step), recorded fine binary values are final_evaluation.stages.fine_binary. No recorded fine value exists for the initial design.

field_maps.component: Ex (dominant, source polarization); Ez and Hy also saved
field_maps.plane: x-z at y=0 (fields are y-invariant: periodic y, normal incidence)

grid.points: cell centres of a uniform subdivision; fields trilinearly interpolated from the Yee grid (collocated)

field_maps.method: DifferentiablePlaneSimulation (the workflow model class) with a y-normal FieldMonitor: frequency-domain (running DFT) plane at 1.0 um, one broadband Gaussian pulse run per design plus one empty-cell reference run for the normalization.
field_maps.project: FineEvaluator settings (25 nm mesh, 16 PML cells = 0.4 um, periodic x/y, Yee material sampling, float32, same plane source Ex 1.0 um 1 cycle) with three changes: z span +-2.95 um instead of +-1.8 um, source at z=-2.45 um instead of -1.2 um (below the saved window, so the region under the layer shows incident plus reflected light), and 8000 steps instead of 1600 (time-converged fields, cf. spectra.duration_check; checked against 12000 steps).
field_maps.normalization: fields / incident Ex phasor at z=0 of the empty-cell run (geometric mean of the rows z=+-0.0125 um, exact for one plane wave)
field_maps.tiling: three periods along x in the saved arrays; columns 60:120 are the simulated cell

history_columns.objective: loss = -(T+1 at 1.0 um), coarse mesh, current smooth density at beta
history_columns.beta: projection beta used for this evaluation
